bull.b: One-year improvements across muscle, kidney, skin, and lung-function measures provide evidence that rese-cel may deliver durable benefits in multiple autoimmune indications. Sustained efficacy could support broader development, differentiation, and eventual commercial potential if later-stage studies confirm these results.

The reported safety profile is a meaningful development strength for an engineered T-cell therapy, where severe immune toxicities can restrict adoption. High rates of minimal CRS, absent ICANS in most patients, and no IEC-HS may support continued trials and physician confidence.

The substantial warrant proceeds strengthen near-term funding flexibility for clinical development and operations. Additional capital can help Cabaletta advance its pipeline without relying immediately on another financing, although the associated share issuance also affects existing ownership.

bear.b: With no approved products and zero revenue, Cabaletta currently lacks recurring operating income to fund research and development. Its financial outlook therefore remains dependent on clinical progress and external capital, making future value highly contingent on successful product development.

Losses have expanded materially as the company continues investing without a revenue base. Persistent deterioration in profitability reduces financial resilience and means that stronger clinical results must eventually translate into partnerships, approvals, or product revenue to support the business economically.

Increasing cash consumption raises the amount of capital required to sustain Cabaletta’s clinical programs and operations. Continued negative free cash flow can shorten funding runway and increase reliance on future equity or other financing, creating dilution and execution risks over the next several quarters.
